app.name: Mavyn
app.startupFailed: The library could not be opened. Your existing data was not replaced.

document.deleteForeverConfirm: Permanently delete “{{title}}” and its history? This cannot be undone.
document.emptyHint: Create a new document, open a file, or drop .md files here.
document.dropHint: Drop Markdown files to add them

conflict.title: This document changed elsewhere
conflict.description: Another tab, device or program saved a newer version. Your edits were not saved and nothing was overwritten.
conflict.keepMine: Save my version as a copy
conflict.undoHint: After loading, your version is still available with Undo.

open.title: Add files
open.description_other: How should these {{count}} files be added?
open.importHint: The library keeps its own copy with history. The original file is not changed.
open.linkHint: Changes are saved to the file on disk. Requires browser permission.
open.linkHintNative: Changes are saved to the original file. Choose a writable file in the system picker.
open.linkUnsupported: This browser cannot edit files in place; the file will be copied into the library.

image.blockedInsecure: Insecure image blocked (http). Only HTTPS images are loaded.

settings.title: Settings
settings.storage: Data is stored locally in this browser.
settings.nativeStorage: Library data is stored in SQLite in this app’s data directory.

history.title: Version history
history.restored: Version restored as a new revision
history.compare: Changes compared with the current version
history.balanced: Keep 30 days, then one per day for a year
history.retentionHint: Changing this setting does not delete history. Cleanup keeps the initial and current revision, and all history of trashed documents.
history.confirmHint: Old revisions outside the selected retention policy will be permanently removed. Current documents stay unchanged. Export a backup first if you need every version.

sync.title: Server
sync.noServer: No sync server serves this address. The web app syncs with the server it is opened from; documents here stay in this browser.
sync.signInHint: Sign in to sync a server library with this device. Accounts are created by the server administrator.
sync.folderHint: Documents of the library appear in a folder of the same name. Everything you put in that folder is uploaded.
sync.connectedTo: Syncing “{{library}}” with the folder of the same name.
sync.removeCopies: Remove synced documents from this device
sync.pendingKept: Documents with changes that were not uploaded are always kept as local documents.
sync.conflictDescription: Your edits overlap with a newer server version and could not be merged automatically. Nothing has been overwritten.
sync.keepBothHint: Keep both: the server version stays here, your text moves to a separate local document.
sync.serverAddressHint: Use an HTTPS origin without a path. Sign out before changing servers. HTTP is allowed only for loopback development.
sync.noNativeServer: Configure a sync server to connect. Your local documents remain available offline.

errors.edit.invalid_range: The edit could not be applied.
errors.edit.stale_revision: The document changed while you clicked. The view was refreshed — please try again.
errors.edit.marker_mismatch: That checkbox no longer matches the source. The view was refreshed.
errors.file.not_utf8: The file is not valid UTF-8 text.
errors.file.external_change: The file changed elsewhere and was not overwritten.
errors.file.permission_denied: Permission to access the file was denied.
errors.file.unsupported: This file type is not supported.
errors.file.write_unsupported: This storage provider cannot safely update the file. Export a Markdown copy instead.
errors.storage.quota_exceeded: Storage is full. Free some space and try again.
errors.sync.offline: You are offline. Changes will sync later.
errors.sync.protocol_unsupported: The server uses an incompatible sync protocol version.
errors.auth.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.auth.csrf_failed: The request was rejected for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.request.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.library.not_found: The server library is no longer available to you.
errors.setup.invalid_token: The setup token is wrong or expired. Copy it again from the server log.
errors.setup.already_completed: The server is already set up. Sign in instead.
errors.user.weak_password: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
errors.user.invalid_username: Use 3–64 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores.
errors.folder.not_found: The folder no longer exists. Choose another destination.
errors.folder.duplicate_name: A folder with this name already exists here.
errors.folder.cycle: A folder cannot be moved inside itself or its subfolders.
errors.storage.busy: The local database is busy in another window. Try again shortly.
errors.storage.schema_unsupported: This library was created by another database version. Update the app before opening it.
errors.storage.migration_conflict: Both the old library and a native library exist. Neither was overwritten. Export or back up both before merging them.
errors.server.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS server address without credentials, path, query, or fragment.

setup.title: Set up the server
setup.intro: This server has no accounts yet. Create the administrator account to start using sync.
setup.tokenHint: The one-time token is printed in the server log. With Docker Compose:
setup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A passphrase of several words works well.
setup.nextStep: Now choose a server library to sync with this device.

folders.localOnlyHint: This changes library organization only. Linked files on disk keep their names and locations.
folders.syncedHint: This document continues syncing with its server library after moving.
folders.uploadHint: Documents placed directly in this folder are uploaded to the connected server library.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.unavailable: The server is not reachable. Check the connection and try again.
auth.hint: Accounts are created by the server administrator.
